before.books/runs-assemble.lisp:
; Layer C: the run assembly. FN2-RUN-ASSEMBLE runs once, after every
; DEFRUNSCHEMA of a world (a top-level assembly book; a unit after its test
; schemas). It generates the layout dispatcher over the registered schemas'
; codecs and key orders, with its shape lemmas proved by cases, then the
; append, page seek, build and lookup written once over the dispatcher and
; guard-verified there, the logic adapters and per-schema keystones, and a
; certify-time check that refuses any assembled schema whose build or lookup
; path reaches a function that is not guard-verified.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "overlay")
(fn2-book-layer :c)

; Dispatch arms over schema rows (NAME . ROW): one case arm per schema id.
; Level 0 selects the entry layout, a positive level the index layout.
(defun fn2-ra-layout-arms (rows suffix args)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom rows) nil
  (let* ((row (cdar rows)) (layouts (fn2-decl-get :layouts row)))
   (cons `(,(fn2-decl-get :id row)
           (if (and (integerp lv) (< 0 lv)) (,(fn2-columns-sym (cadr layouts) suffix) ,@args)
             (,(fn2-columns-sym (car layouts) suffix) ,@args)))
         (fn2-ra-layout-arms (cdr rows) suffix args)))))
(defun fn2-ra-layout-max-sizes (rows)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom rows) nil
  (let ((layouts (fn2-decl-get :layouts (cdar rows))))
   (cons (fn2-codec-constant (car layouts) "-MAX-SIZE")
    (cons (fn2-codec-constant (cadr layouts) "-MAX-SIZE")
          (fn2-ra-layout-max-sizes (cdr rows)))))))
(defun fn2-ra-layout-max-expression (sizes)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom sizes) 0 `(max ,(car sizes) ,(fn2-ra-layout-max-expression (cdr sizes)))))
(defun fn2-ra-count-arms (rows)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom rows) nil
  (let* ((row (cdar rows)) (layouts (fn2-decl-get :layouts row)))
   (cons `(,(fn2-decl-get :id row)
           (if (and (integerp lv) (< 0 lv)) ,(fn2-codec-constant (cadr layouts) "-NUM-FIELDS")
             ,(fn2-codec-constant (car layouts) "-NUM-FIELDS")))
         (fn2-ra-count-arms (cdr rows))))))
; The declared schema kind is consumed by writers and readers. Directory
; index pages remain :manifest; ordinary positive-level pages are :run-index.
(defun fn2-ra-fields-physical-ref-p (fields)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (and (consp fields) (or (equal (cadar fields) '(:id physical-unit)) (fn2-ra-fields-physical-ref-p (cdr fields)))))
(defun fn2-ra-physical-ref-arms (rows)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom rows) nil
  (cons `(,(fn2-decl-get :id (cdar rows))
          ,(if (fn2-ra-fields-physical-ref-p (append (fn2-decl-get :key (cdar rows)) (fn2-decl-get :value (cdar rows)))) t nil))
        (fn2-ra-physical-ref-arms (cdr rows)))))
(defun fn2-ra-page-kind-arms (rows)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom rows) nil
  (cons `(,(fn2-decl-get :id (cdar rows))
          ,(if (eq (fn2-decl-get :page-kind (cdar rows)) :manifest) '*page-kind-manifest*
             '(if (and (integerp lv) (< 0 lv)) *page-kind-run-index* *page-kind-run-data*)))
        (fn2-ra-page-kind-arms (cdr rows)))))
(defun fn2-ra-key-arms (rows)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom rows) nil
  (cons `(,(fn2-decl-get :id (cdar rows)) ,(len (fn2-decl-get :key (cdar rows))))
        (fn2-ra-key-arms (cdr rows)))))
(defun fn2-ra-compare-arms (rows)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom rows) nil
  (cons `(,(fn2-decl-get :id (cdar rows))
          (,(fn2-decl-get :compare (cdar rows)) abase bbase ak as ag bk bs bg fn2-fields fn2-pool))
        (fn2-ra-compare-arms (cdr rows)))))
(defun fn2-ra-merge-arms (rows)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom rows) nil
  (cons `(,(fn2-decl-get :id (cdar rows)) ,(fn2-decl-get :merge (cdar rows))) (fn2-ra-merge-arms (cdr rows)))))
(defun fn2-ra-fold-arms (rows)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((atom rows) nil)
       ((fn2-decl-get :fold (cdar rows))
        (cons `(,(fn2-decl-get :id (cdar rows)) (,(fn2-columns-sym (caar rows) "-FOLD-APPLY") kind vbase abase fn2-fields))
              (fn2-ra-fold-arms (cdr rows))))
       (t (fn2-ra-fold-arms (cdr rows)))))
;; What the private successor (C-S3) needs of each fold, from its declaration:
;; the arity of each event kind, which args are assigned, which arg each key
;; field is; and of every schema, which entry fields are octets.
(defun fn2-ra-pos (x xs)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((atom xs) 0) ((eq x (car xs)) 0) (t (+ 1 (fn2-ra-pos x (cdr xs))))))
(defun fn2-ra-poss (names xs)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom names) nil (cons (fn2-ra-pos (car names) xs) (fn2-ra-poss (cdr names) xs))))
(defun fn2-ra-evs (row) (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil)) (cadr (member-eq :events (fn2-decl-get :fold row))))
(defun fn2-ra-ev-assigns (ev) (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil)) (strip-cars (cadr (member-eq :assign (cddr ev)))))
(defun fn2-ra-key-arg-arms (knames args k)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom knames) nil (cons `(,k ,(fn2-ra-pos (car knames) args)) (fn2-ra-key-arg-arms (cdr knames) args (+ 1 k)))))
(defun fn2-ra-kind-arms (evs what key)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom evs) nil
  (let ((args (cadar evs)))
   (cons `(,(caar evs)
           ,(case what
             (:arity (len args))
             (:assigned `(if (member-equal j ',(fn2-ra-poss (fn2-ra-ev-assigns (car evs)) args)) t nil))
             (otherwise `(case k ,@(fn2-ra-key-arg-arms (strip-cars key) args 0) (otherwise nil)))))
         (fn2-ra-kind-arms (cdr evs) what key)))))
(defun fn2-ra-fold-info-arms (rows what)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((atom rows) nil)
       ((fn2-decl-get :fold (cdar rows))
        (cons `(,(fn2-decl-get :id (cdar rows))
                (case kind ,@(fn2-ra-kind-arms (fn2-ra-evs (cdar rows)) what (fn2-decl-get :key (cdar rows))) (otherwise nil)))
              (fn2-ra-fold-info-arms (cdr rows) what)))
       (t (fn2-ra-fold-info-arms (cdr rows) what))))
;; An event-filled arg (C-S3 grown for AUTHORITY-20261105 section 2's folds):
;; arg A of event EV whose :set copies it straight into one value field F,
;; (F A), and which nothing else reads (not a key, not assigned, absent from
;; :when, :assign and every other :set). Its value may be the member's own
;; commit position, :event at fn2-succ-arg: stage applies the step with 0 in
;; its place and bind writes the position into F (entry field NK + F's
;; position), so the post-image is the step over the event bind gave it.
(defun fn2-ra-occurs (x tree)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom tree) (eq x tree) (or (fn2-ra-occurs x (car tree)) (fn2-ra-occurs x (cdr tree)))))
(defun fn2-ra-straight-sets (a sets)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((atom sets) nil)
       ((eq (cadar sets) a) (cons (caar sets) (fn2-ra-straight-sets a (cdr sets))))
       (t (fn2-ra-straight-sets a (cdr sets)))))
(defun fn2-ra-other-sets (a sets)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((atom sets) nil)
       ((eq (cadar sets) a) (fn2-ra-other-sets a (cdr sets)))
       (t (cons (cadar sets) (fn2-ra-other-sets a (cdr sets))))))
(defun fn2-ra-event-arg-arms (args j ev knames vnames)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom args) nil
  (let* ((a (car args)) (sets (cadr (member-eq :set (cddr ev))))
         (fs (fn2-ra-straight-sets a sets))
         (ok (and (not (member-eq a knames)) (not (member-eq a (fn2-ra-ev-assigns ev)))
                  (equal (len fs) 1) (member-eq (car fs) vnames)
                  (not (fn2-ra-occurs a (cadr (member-eq :when (cddr ev)))))
                  (not (fn2-ra-occurs a (cadr (member-eq :assign (cddr ev)))))
                  (not (fn2-ra-occurs a (fn2-ra-other-sets a sets))))))
   (if ok (cons `(,j ,(+ (len knames) (fn2-ra-pos (car fs) vnames))) (fn2-ra-event-arg-arms (cdr args) (+ 1 j) ev knames vnames))
     (fn2-ra-event-arg-arms (cdr args) (+ 1 j) ev knames vnames)))))
(defun fn2-ra-event-kind-arms (evs knames vnames)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom evs) nil
  (cons `(,(caar evs) (case j ,@(fn2-ra-event-arg-arms (cadar evs) 0 (car evs) knames vnames) (otherwise nil)))
        (fn2-ra-event-kind-arms (cdr evs) knames vnames))))
(defun fn2-ra-event-field-arms (rows)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((atom rows) nil)
       ((fn2-decl-get :fold (cdar rows))
        (cons `(,(fn2-decl-get :id (cdar rows))
                (case kind ,@(fn2-ra-event-kind-arms (fn2-ra-evs (cdar rows)) (strip-cars (fn2-decl-get :key (cdar rows)))
                                                     (strip-cars (fn2-decl-get :value (cdar rows))))
                 (otherwise nil)))
              (fn2-ra-event-field-arms (cdr rows))))
       (t (fn2-ra-event-field-arms (cdr rows)))))
(defun fn2-ra-assign-arms (rows)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((atom rows) nil)
       ((fn2-decl-get :fold (cdar rows))
        (cons `(,(fn2-decl-get :id (cdar rows)) (,(fn2-columns-sym (caar rows) "-FOLD-ASSIGN") kind vbase abase fn2-fields))
              (fn2-ra-assign-arms (cdr rows))))
       (t (fn2-ra-assign-arms (cdr rows)))))
(defun fn2-ra-field-arms (fields i what)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom fields) nil
  (let* ((kind (cadar fields))
         (arm (case what
               (:octets (cond ((eq kind :digest) 32) ((and (consp kind) (eq (car kind) :octets)) (cadr kind)) (t nil)))
               (otherwise (cond ((member-eq kind '(:u8 :u16 :u32)) `(unsigned-byte-p ,(case kind (:u8 8) (:u16 16) (otherwise 32)) v))
                                ((eq kind :bool) '(unsigned-byte-p 1 v))
                                ((and (consp kind) (eq (car kind) :enum)) `(and (natp v) (< v ,(len (caddr kind)))))
                                ((eq kind :digest) '(equal v 32))
                                ((and (consp kind) (eq (car kind) :octets)) `(and (natp v) (<= v ,(cadr kind))))
                                (t nil))))))
   (if arm (cons `(,i ,arm) (fn2-ra-field-arms (cdr fields) (+ 1 i) what)) (fn2-ra-field-arms (cdr fields) (+ 1 i) what)))))
(defun fn2-ra-fields-arms (rows what)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom rows) nil
  (cons `(,(fn2-decl-get :id (cdar rows))
          (case f ,@(fn2-ra-field-arms (append (fn2-decl-get :key (cdar rows)) (fn2-decl-get :value (cdar rows))) 0 what)
           (otherwise ,(if (eq what :octets) nil t))))
        (fn2-ra-fields-arms (cdr rows) what))))
(defun fn2-ra-fold-ids (rows)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((atom rows) nil)
       ((fn2-decl-get :fold (cdar rows)) (cons (fn2-decl-get :id (cdar rows)) (fn2-ra-fold-ids (cdr rows))))
       (t (fn2-ra-fold-ids (cdr rows)))))
(defun fn2-ra-add-kinds (evs acc)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((atom evs) acc)
       ((member-eq (caar evs) acc) (fn2-ra-add-kinds (cdr evs) acc))
       (t (fn2-ra-add-kinds (cdr evs) (cons (caar evs) acc)))))
(defun fn2-ra-fold-kinds (rows acc)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom rows) (reverse acc)
  (fn2-ra-fold-kinds (cdr rows) (fn2-ra-add-kinds (fn2-ra-evs (cdar rows)) acc))))
(defun fn2-ra-ids (rows)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom rows) nil (cons (fn2-decl-get :id (cdar rows)) (fn2-ra-ids (cdr rows)))))

; The dispatcher. Every function is total over schema ids: an id no schema
; registered is refused :schema by the codec dispatch and has no fields.
(defun fn2-ra-dispatch-events (rows)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (let ((room '(and (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (natp base)
                   (<= (+ base *fn2-run-entry-rows*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)))))
 `((defconst *fn2-run-layout-max-entry-bytes* ,(fn2-ra-layout-max-expression (fn2-ra-layout-max-sizes rows)))
   (defun fn2-run-layout-physical-ref-p (sid)
    (declare (xargs :guard t))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-physical-ref-arms rows) (otherwise t)))
   (defun fn2-run-layout-page-kind (sid lv)
    (declare (xargs :guard t) (ignorable lv))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-page-kind-arms rows) (otherwise nil)))
   (defun fn2-run-layout-fields (sid lv)
    (declare (xargs :guard t) (ignorable lv))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-count-arms rows) (otherwise 0)))
   (defun fn2-run-layout-keys (sid)
    (declare (xargs :guard t))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-key-arms rows) (otherwise 0)))
   (defun fn2-run-layout-decode (sid lv base slot gen off end okind oslot ogen fn2-fields fn2-pool)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-fields fn2-pool) :guard (and ,room (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool)))
             (ignorable lv base slot gen end okind oslot ogen fn2-pool))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-layout-arms rows "-DECODE" '(base slot gen off end okind oslot ogen fn2-fields fn2-pool))
     (otherwise (mv :schema off fn2-fields))))
   (defun fn2-run-layout-encode (sid lv base slot gen off okind oslot ogen fn2-fields fn2-pool)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-fields fn2-pool) :guard (and ,room (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool)))
             (ignorable lv base slot gen okind oslot ogen fn2-fields))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-layout-arms rows "-ENCODE" '(base slot gen off okind oslot ogen fn2-fields fn2-pool))
     (otherwise (mv :schema off fn2-pool))))
   (defun fn2-run-layout-size (sid lv base fn2-fields)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-fields :guard ,room) (ignorable lv base fn2-fields))
    (nfix (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-layout-arms rows "-SIZE" '(base fn2-fields)) (otherwise 0))))
   (defun fn2-run-layout-compare (sid abase bbase ak as ag bk bs bg fn2-fields fn2-pool)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-fields fn2-pool)
     :guard (and (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool) (natp abase) (natp bbase)
                 (<= (+ abase *fn2-run-entry-rows*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))
                 (<= (+ bbase *fn2-run-entry-rows*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))))
             (ignorable abase bbase ak as ag bk bs bg fn2-fields fn2-pool))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-compare-arms rows) (otherwise (mv :schema :eq))))
   ;; The schema's merge rule (C-RANGE-NEWEST: a :latest overlay replaces
   ;; an equal key) and, for a fold, its served step over decoded rows.
   (defun fn2-run-layout-merge (sid)
    (declare (xargs :guard t))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-merge-arms rows) (otherwise :unique)))
   (defun fn2-fold-apply (sid kind vbase abase fn2-fields)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-fields :guard (and (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (natp vbase) (natp abase)))
             (ignorable sid kind vbase abase))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-fold-arms rows) (otherwise (mv :schema fn2-fields))))
   ;; The fold's assigned args of event KIND from the row at VBASE.
   (defun fn2-fold-assign (sid kind vbase abase fn2-fields)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-fields :guard (and (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (natp vbase) (natp abase)))
             (ignorable sid kind vbase abase))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-assign-arms rows) (otherwise (mv :schema fn2-fields))))
   ;; Event KIND of fold SID: its arity, or nil when it is none of the
   ;; fold's; whether its arg J is assigned; the arg that is key field K.
   (defun fn2-fold-arity (sid kind)
    (declare (xargs :guard t) (ignorable kind))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-fold-info-arms rows :arity) (otherwise nil)))
   (defun fn2-fold-assigned-p (sid kind j)
    (declare (xargs :guard t) (ignorable kind j))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-fold-info-arms rows :assigned) (otherwise nil)))
   (defun fn2-fold-key-arg (sid kind k)
    (declare (xargs :guard t) (ignorable kind k))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-fold-info-arms rows :key) (otherwise nil)))
   ;; The entry field bind fills with the member's commit position when
   ;; arg J of event KIND of fold SID is given :event, or nil when J may not
   ;; be (fn2-ra-event-arg-arms).
   (defun fn2-fold-event-field (sid kind j)
    (declare (xargs :guard t) (ignorable kind j))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-event-field-arms rows) (otherwise nil)))
   ;; Entry field F of schema SID: the greatest length when it is octets
   ;; (a digest's is 32), else nil; whether V fits it (for an octet field V
   ;; is the length: a digest's is exactly 32).
   (defun fn2-run-layout-octets-max (sid f)
    (declare (xargs :guard t) (ignorable f))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-fields-arms rows :octets) (otherwise nil)))
   (defun fn2-run-layout-value-ok (sid f v)
    (declare (xargs :guard t) (ignorable f v))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-fields-arms rows :value) (otherwise nil)))
   (defun fn2-run-layout-fold-p (sid)
    (declare (xargs :guard t))
    (if (member-equal sid ',(fn2-ra-fold-ids rows)) t nil))
   (defconst *fn2-run-fold-kinds* ',(fn2-ra-fold-kinds rows nil))
   (defconst *fn2-run-assembled-ids* ',(fn2-ra-ids rows)))))

; A shape lemma (recognizer, invariant, rows) for each named output, proved
; with the recognizers and the named rows accessors folded.
(defmacro fn2-ra-shape (name call guard outputs disables)
 `(defthm ,name
   (implies ,guard (and ,@(fn2-fc-shape-claims outputs call)))
   :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-run-writersp fn2-run-writers-wfp fn2-run-restartsp fn2-run-restarts-wfp
                                       fn2-run-cursorsp fn2-run-cursors-wfp fn2-run-pathsp fn2-run-paths-wfp
                                       fn2-fieldsp fn2-fields-wfp fn2-poolp fn2-pool-wfp ,@disables)))))

; Shape lemmas, by cases over the arms, from each codec's own lemmas.
(defmacro fn2-ra-shape-events ()
 '(progn
   (defthm fn2-fold-apply-shape
    (implies (and (fn2-fieldsp fn2-fields) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields))
             (and (fn2-fieldsp (mv-nth 1 (fn2-fold-apply sid kind vbase abase fn2-fields)))
                  (fn2-fields-wfp (mv-nth 1 (fn2-fold-apply sid kind vbase abase fn2-fields)))
                  (equal (fn2-fields-rows (mv-nth 1 (fn2-fold-apply sid kind vbase abase fn2-fields)))
                         (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))))
    :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-fieldsp fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields-rows))))
   (defthm fn2-fold-assign-shape
    (implies (and (fn2-fieldsp fn2-fields) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields))
             (and (fn2-fieldsp (mv-nth 1 (fn2-fold-assign sid kind vbase abase fn2-fields)))
                  (fn2-fields-wfp (mv-nth 1 (fn2-fold-assign sid kind vbase abase fn2-fields)))
                  (equal (fn2-fields-rows (mv-nth 1 (fn2-fold-assign sid kind vbase abase fn2-fields)))
                         (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))))
    :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-fieldsp fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields-rows))))
   (defthm fn2-fold-key-arg-type
    (or (null (fn2-fold-key-arg sid kind k)) (natp (fn2-fold-key-arg sid kind k))) :rule-classes :type-prescription)
   (defthm fn2-fold-event-field-type
    (or (null (fn2-fold-event-field sid kind j)) (natp (fn2-fold-event-field sid kind j))) :rule-classes :type-prescription)
   (defthm fn2-fold-arity-type
    (or (null (fn2-fold-arity sid kind)) (natp (fn2-fold-arity sid kind))) :rule-classes :type-prescription)
   (defthm fn2-run-layout-octets-max-type
    (or (null (fn2-run-layout-octets-max sid f)) (natp (fn2-run-layout-octets-max sid f))) :rule-classes :type-prescription)
   (in-theory (disable fn2-fold-assign fn2-fold-arity fn2-fold-assigned-p fn2-fold-key-arg fn2-fold-event-field
                       fn2-run-layout-octets-max fn2-run-layout-value-ok fn2-run-layout-fold-p))
   (defthm fn2-run-layout-decode-shape
    (implies (and (fn2-fieldsp fn2-fields) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields))
             (and (fn2-fieldsp (mv-nth 2 (fn2-run-layout-decode sid lv base slot gen off end okind oslot ogen fn2-fields fn2-pool)))
                  (fn2-fields-wfp (mv-nth 2 (fn2-run-layout-decode sid lv base slot gen off end okind oslot ogen fn2-fields fn2-pool)))
                  (equal (fn2-fields-rows (mv-nth 2 (fn2-run-layout-decode sid lv base slot gen off end okind oslot ogen fn2-fields fn2-pool)))
                         (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))))
    :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-fieldsp fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields-rows))))
   (defthm fn2-run-layout-encode-shape
    (implies (and (fn2-poolp fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool))
             (and (fn2-poolp (mv-nth 2 (fn2-run-layout-encode sid lv base slot gen off okind oslot ogen fn2-fields fn2-pool)))
                  (fn2-pool-wfp (mv-nth 2 (fn2-run-layout-encode sid lv base slot gen off okind oslot ogen fn2-fields fn2-pool)))
                  (equal (fn2-pool-rows (mv-nth 2 (fn2-run-layout-encode sid lv base slot gen off okind oslot ogen fn2-fields fn2-pool)))
                         (fn2-pool-rows fn2-pool))))
    :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-poolp fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool-rows))))
   (defthm fn2-run-layout-size-natp
    (implies (and (fn2-fieldsp fn2-fields) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (natp base)
                  (<= (+ base *fn2-run-entry-rows*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)))
             (natp (fn2-run-layout-size sid lv base fn2-fields)))
    :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-fields-rows)))
    :rule-classes :type-prescription)
   (in-theory (disable fn2-run-layout-decode fn2-run-layout-encode fn2-run-layout-size fn2-run-layout-compare))))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Written once over the dispatcher.

; The append (ready, then write) and the page seek.
(defmacro fn2-ra-page-events ()
 '(progn
   ; Whether entry EBASE can be appended now: :ok, or the refusal; nothing changes.
   (defun fn2-run-add-ready (w sid ebase fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool)

   ; entry whose key is >= the query at QBASE. Binary search over restarts

         ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code lo hi idx off fn2-fields))
         ((mv code order) (fn2-run-layout-compare sid eb qbase pk ps pg qk qs qg fn2-fields fn2-pool))
         ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code lo hi idx off fn2-fields)))

      (:gt (mv :absent lo hi idx off fn2-fields))

                     (fn2-run-seek sid lv (- steps 1) lo hi (+ 1 idx) next qbase rb slot gen pk ps pg qk qs qg fn2-fields fn2-pool)

;; Lookup and scan. FN2-RUN-NTH decodes entry K of a read page at level LV

;; verify it under its parent-held hash, put it in the cache, and step again),
;; or the final :found / :absent with the level-0 entry decoded in the reader
;; rows. Every page the descent visits is noted in the cursor's path.
;; FN2-RUN-SCAN-STEP continues from a lower bound: :entry (the next entry in

     :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-fields-rows)))))

          ((mv code next fn2-fields)

          ((unless (and (eq code :ok) (natp next) (< off next))) (mv (if (eq code :ok) :format code) off fn2-fields)))

    (and (fn2-fieldsp fn2-fields) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields)) ((fn2-fields 2)))

     :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-fields-rows fn2-run-restart-offset)))))

      (implies (and (fn2-run-run-inputp ,layout ',key entries limit) (fn2-run-values-layoutp ,layout q))
               (equal (fn2-run-lookup-image ,id ,layout entries limit q) (fn2-run-key-lookup-spec ',key entries q)))
      :teeth (,(fn2-columns-sym name "-RUN-LOOKUP-EXACT-POSITIVE") ,(fn2-columns-sym name "-RUN-LOOKUP-EXACT-NEGATIVE"))
      :schema :g1 :claim :representation :shared ((:schema ,name))
      :doc "A run built through the real build entry points and searched through the real cursor steps finds the entry whose key equals the query, and only that; otherwise it answers :absent.")
    `(defthm-owed ,(fn2-columns-sym name "-RUN-SCAN") (entries limit q n)
      (implies (and (fn2-run-run-inputp ,layout ',key entries limit) (fn2-run-values-layoutp ,layout q) (natp n))
               (equal (fn2-run-scan-image ,id ,layout entries limit q n) (fn2-run-scan-spec ',key entries q n)))
      :teeth (,(fn2-columns-sym name "-RUN-SCAN-POSITIVE") ,(fn2-columns-sym name "-RUN-SCAN-NEGATIVE"))
      :schema :g1 :claim :representation :shared ((:schema ,name))
      :doc "A scan positioned at the lower bound of the query through the real cursor steps delivers the run's entries in key order, across pages and levels, and ends exactly when they do.")
    `(defthm-owed ,(fn2-columns-sym name "-OVERLAY-SORTED") (entries)
      (implies (fn2-ov-inputp ,layout ',key entries)
               (equal (fn2-ov-image ,id ,layout entries) (fn2-ov-image-spec ',key entries)))
      :teeth (,(fn2-columns-sym name "-OVERLAY-SORTED-POSITIVE") ,(fn2-columns-sym name "-OVERLAY-SORTED-NEGATIVE"))
      :schema :g1 :claim :representation :shared ((:schema ,name))
      :doc "Entries inserted into the active overlay in any order through the real insert all succeed when their keys are distinct, and read back in key order.")
    (fn2-ra-keystone-events (cdr rows))))))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; The glue check. A schema's build and lookup path is the generic entry
; points, the dispatcher, its codecs and key order, every function its
; declaration generated, and any per-schema glue by the old names that
; exists. Each must be :common-lisp-compliant, or the schema is refused by
; name: (:unverified schema function). The snapshot pairs each schema with
; (function . symbol-class) for its path, taken from the world.
(defconst *fn2-run-glue-generic*
 '(fn2-run-layout-fields fn2-run-layout-keys fn2-run-layout-decode fn2-run-layout-encode
   fn2-run-layout-size fn2-run-layout-compare fn2-run-add-ready fn2-run-add-write fn2-run-add fn2-run-seek fn2-run-build-add
   fn2-run-build-promote fn2-run-build-work fn2-run-build-start fn2-run-build-page fn2-run-build-finish
   fn2-run-skip fn2-run-nth fn2-run-step-header fn2-run-step-seek fn2-run-step-child fn2-run-step-deliver fn2-run-step-up fn2-run-phase-header fn2-run-phase-seek fn2-run-phase-child fn2-run-phase-deliver fn2-run-phase-up fn2-run-cursor-step fn2-run-lookup-step fn2-run-scan-step fn2-ov-entry fn2-ov-order fn2-ov-search fn2-ov-locate fn2-ov-write fn2-ov-insert fn2-ov-start fn2-ov-place fn2-ov-reput fn2-ov-insert-at fn2-run-cursor-start fn2-run-cache-install))
(defconst *fn2-run-glue-old-suffixes*
 '("-ENTRY-ADD" "-INDEX-ADD" "-ENTRY-SEEK" "-INDEX-SEEK" "-BUILD-ADD" "-BUILD-PROMOTE"
   "-INDEX-SKIP" "-INDEX-NTH" "-LOOKUP-STEP"))
(defun fn2-ra-sym-list (name suffixes)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom suffixes) nil (cons (fn2-columns-sym name (car suffixes)) (fn2-ra-sym-list name (cdr suffixes)))))
(defun fn2-ra-existing-old (names world)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom names) nil
  (if (function-symbolp (car names) world) (cons (car names) (fn2-ra-existing-old (cdr names) world))
    (fn2-ra-existing-old (cdr names) world))))
(defun fn2-ra-generated-functions (manifest)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom manifest) nil
  (if (eq (caar manifest) :function) (cons (cadar manifest) (fn2-ra-generated-functions (cdr manifest)))
    (fn2-ra-generated-functions (cdr manifest)))))
(defun fn2-ra-classes (names world)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom names) nil
  (cons (cons (car names) (getpropc (car names) 'symbol-class nil world)) (fn2-ra-classes (cdr names) world))))
; The first function of PAIRS that is not guard-verified, or nil.
(defun fn2-run-glue-unverified (pairs)
 (declare (xargs :guard t))
 (cond ((atom pairs) nil)
       ((and (consp (car pairs)) (eq (cdar pairs) :common-lisp-compliant)) (fn2-run-glue-unverified (cdr pairs)))
       (t (if (consp (car pairs)) (caar pairs) (car pairs)))))
(defun fn2-run-glue-check (snapshot)
 (declare (xargs :guard t))
 (cond ((atom snapshot) :ok)
       ((not (consp (car snapshot))) (list :unverified nil nil))
       ((fn2-run-glue-unverified (cdar snapshot)) (list :unverified (caar snapshot) (fn2-run-glue-unverified (cdar snapshot))))
       (t (fn2-run-glue-check (cdr snapshot)))))
(defun fn2-ra-glue-names (name row world)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (let ((layouts (fn2-decl-get :layouts row)))
  (append *fn2-run-glue-generic*
          (list (fn2-columns-sym (car layouts) "-ENCODE") (fn2-columns-sym (car layouts) "-DECODE")
                (fn2-columns-sym (car layouts) "-SIZE") (fn2-columns-sym (cadr layouts) "-ENCODE")
                (fn2-columns-sym (cadr layouts) "-DECODE") (fn2-columns-sym (cadr layouts) "-SIZE")
                (fn2-decl-get :compare row))
          (fn2-ra-generated-functions (fn2-decl-get :generated row))
          (fn2-ra-existing-old (fn2-ra-sym-list name *fn2-run-glue-old-suffixes*) world))))
(defun fn2-ra-glue-snapshot (rows world)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom rows) nil
  (cons (cons (caar rows) (fn2-ra-classes (fn2-ra-glue-names (caar rows) (cdar rows) world) world))
        (fn2-ra-glue-snapshot (cdr rows) world))))
;; One assembly per world, after its last schema. The owed row records the
;; certify-time check; its teeth: the assembled schemas pass, and a schema
;; carrying per-schema glue admitted without guard verification is refused
;; by name.
;; The generated proofs run in one theory, whatever the including world's.
;; deflayout disables the fields and pool accessors locally in each codec's
;; book; a world that includes a schema's certified book has them enabled
;; again, and the assembly's proofs there took ten times as long (159 s
;; against 17 s). The assembly folds the same accessors, and the rows
;; accessors of the digest and checker tables, as runs.lisp does.
(defmacro fn2-run-assembly-theory ()
 '(local (in-theory (disable fn2-fieldsp fn2-poolp fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields-value fn2-fields-ref-slot
                             fn2-fields-ref-gen fn2-fields-ref-off fn2-fields-ref-len fn2-fields-status fn2-pool-rows
                             fn2-pool-read fn2-pool-write fn2-fields-decode-phase fn2-fields-decode-pos fn2-fields-decode-acc
                             fn2-fields-decode-high fn2-fields-decode-size fn2-fields-decode-ref fn2-fields-decode-payload
                             fn2-fields-decode-next fn2-digests-rows fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc-context-rows fn2-b3-rows))))
(defmacro fn2-run-assemble ()
 '(encapsulate ()
   (fn2-run-assembly-theory)
   (make-event
    (if (fn2-rs-assembled (w state))
        (er soft 'fn2-run-assemble "The runs are already assembled: ~x0." (fn2-rs-assembled (w state)))
      (value `(table fn2-run-assembly :schemas ',(strip-cars (fn2-decl-rows :schema (w state))))))
    :check-expansion t)
   (make-event (value (cons 'progn (fn2-ra-dispatch-events (fn2-decl-rows :schema (w state))))))
   (fn2-ra-shape-events)
   (fn2-ra-page-events)
   (fn2-ra-build-events)
   (fn2-ra-lookup-events)
   (fn2-ra-overlay-events)
   (fn2-ra-adapter-events)
   (fn2-ra-overlay-adapter-events)
   (make-event (value (cons 'progn (fn2-ra-keystone-events (fn2-decl-rows :schema (w state))))))
   (make-event
    (value `(defun fn2-run-glue-assembled ()
              (declare (xargs :guard t))
              ',(fn2-ra-glue-snapshot (fn2-decl-rows :schema (w state)) (w state)))))
   (defthm-owed fn2-run-glue-verified ()
    (equal (fn2-run-glue-check (fn2-run-glue-assembled)) :ok)
    :teeth (fn2-run-glue-verified-positive fn2-run-glue-verified-negative)
    :schema :invariant
    :doc "Every assembled schema's build and lookup path (generic entry points, dispatcher, codecs, key order, generated functions, any per-schema glue) is guard-verified; the assembly refuses otherwise, by name.")
   (make-event
    (let ((r (fn2-run-glue-check (fn2-run-glue-assembled))))
     (if (eq r :ok) (value '(value-triple :glue-verified))
       (er soft 'fn2-run-assemble "Run schema ~x0: ~x1 is not guard-verified." (cadr r) (caddr r)))))))
before.books/machines-c-bind.lisp:
; Layer C in the served core, seam C-S3 (docs/c-ordered-runs.md §8 item 8):
; bind (every staged row into the batch's private overlays), release at the
; outcome, B's publish and drop, the defcosts, and the core wrappers of the
; whole seam (fn2-successor-prepare-events and -commit-events, materialized in
; assembly-callbacks-c.lisp). The tables and the :prepare half are
; machines-c-successor.lisp's, stage machines-c-stage.lisp's (C-SUCCESSOR-BOOK).
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "machines-c-stage")
(fn2-book-layer :c)
(local (in-theory (disable fn2-run-layout-fields fn2-run-layout-keys fn2-run-layout-merge fn2-run-layout-size
                           fn2-fold-key-arg fn2-fold-arity fn2-fold-assigned-p fn2-run-layout-octets-max
                           fn2-run-layout-value-ok fn2-run-layout-fold-p fn2-run-version fn2-succ-bit fn2-succ-has)))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Bind (right after B's admission :ok, in the same transition): every slot's
; row enters BATCH's private overlay of its schema, the newest one with room
; or a held spare. Nothing here fails after an :ok stage but a broken
; invariant.

; Copy N bytes from [SOFF..) of SSLOT/SGEN (read under SK SS SG) to
; [DOFF..) of DSLOT/DGEN (written under the engine's owner). Interim until
; A-S8's fn2-pool-copy-across lands (D's interim is the same loop).
(defun fn2-idc-copy (n sslot sgen soff sk ss sg dslot dgen doff fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-pool :measure (nfix n) :guard (and (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool) (natp n) (natp soff) (natp doff)) :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-pool-reserve fn2-pool-release fn2-pool-reset fn2-pool-read fn2-pool-write
                                             fn2-pool-class-for fn2-ov-start fn2-ov-advance fn2-ov-insert
                                             fn2-ov-locate fn2-ov-entry fn2-run-copy-row fn2-fold-apply fn2-fold-assign
                                             fn2-run-layout-size fn2-run-lookup-step fn2-run-cursor-start
                                             fn2-fields-rows fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-overlays-rows)))))
 (if (zp n) (mv :ok fn2-pool)
  (b* (((mv code byte) (fn2-pool-read sslot sgen soff sk ss sg fn2-pool))
       ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-pool))
       ((mv code fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-write dslot dgen doff byte *fn2-idc-owner-kind* *fn2-idc-owner-slot* *fn2-idc-owner-gen* fn2-pool))
       ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-pool)))
   (fn2-idc-copy (- n 1) sslot sgen (+ 1 soff) sk ss sg dslot dgen (+ 1 doff) fn2-pool))))
(fn2-pool-preserves fn2-idc-copy (n sslot sgen soff sk ss sg dslot dgen doff fn2-pool) :position 1
 :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-pool-read fn2-pool-write fn2-pool-rows))))

; An insert's octet fields J.. of the row at ENTRY copied into the scratch
; from OFF on (read under SK SS SG), each field then naming its copy.
(defun fn2-succ-rehome-octets (k j sid entry off sk ss sg sslot sgen fn2-fields fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-fields fn2-pool) :measure (nfix k)
  :guard (and (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool) (natp j) (natp entry) (natp off))
  :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-idc-copy fn2-fields-rows fn2-run-layout-octets-max)))))
 (b* (((unless (and (posp k) (natp j) (natp entry) (natp off) (< (+ entry j) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)))) (mv :ok fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      ((unless (fn2-run-layout-octets-max sid j))
       (fn2-succ-rehome-octets (- k 1) (+ 1 j) sid entry off sk ss sg sslot sgen fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      (row (+ entry j)) (len (fn2-fields-ref-len row fn2-fields))
      ((unless (and (natp (fn2-fields-ref-off row fn2-fields)) (natp len) (unsigned-byte-p 32 off) (unsigned-byte-p 32 (+ off len))
                    (unsigned-byte-p 32 sslot) (unsigned-byte-p 60 sgen)))
       (mv :bounds fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      ((mv code fn2-pool) (fn2-idc-copy len (fn2-fields-ref-slot row fn2-fields) (fn2-fields-ref-gen row fn2-fields)
                                        (fn2-fields-ref-off row fn2-fields) sk ss sg sslot sgen off fn2-pool))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-put row (ref-slot sslot) (ref-gen sgen) (ref-off off))))
  (fn2-succ-rehome-octets (- k 1) (+ 1 j) sid entry (+ off len) sk ss sg sslot sgen fn2-fields fn2-pool)))
(fn2-idc-fn-shape fn2-succ-rehome-octets (k j sid entry off sk ss sg sslot sgen fn2-fields fn2-pool) (fn2-fields fn2-pool)
 (fn2-fields fn2-pool) t (fn2-run-layout-octets-max fn2-fields-ref-len fn2-fields-ref-off fn2-fields-ref-slot fn2-fields-ref-gen fn2-idc-copy))

; Integer fields J.. of the row at ENTRY given :event take EVENT.
(defun fn2-succ-fill-events (k j entry events event fn2-fields)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-fields :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (natp j) (natp entry))))
 (cond ((not (and (posp k) (natp j) (natp entry) (< (+ entry j) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)) (unsigned-byte-p 60 event))) fn2-fields)
       ((fn2-succ-has events j)
        (let ((fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value (+ entry j) event fn2-fields)))
         (fn2-succ-fill-events (- k 1) (+ 1 j) entry events event fn2-fields)))
       (t (fn2-succ-fill-events (- k 1) (+ 1 j) entry events event fn2-fields))))
(fn2-fields-preserves fn2-succ-fill-events (k j entry events event fn2-fields) :position nil :raw-rows t
 :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-succ-has))))

; Fold slot (SID, event KW): for each arg J.. (K of them) given :event, the
; entry field fn2-fold-event-field names (the value field its :set copies
; the arg into) takes EVENT; stage applied the step with 0 in its place.
(defun fn2-succ-fill-fold-events (k j sid kw entry events event fn2-fields)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-fields :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (natp j) (natp entry))))
 (cond ((not (and (posp k) (natp j) (natp entry) (unsigned-byte-p 60 event))) fn2-fields)
       ((and (fn2-succ-has events j) (natp (fn2-fold-event-field sid kw j))
             (< (+ entry (fn2-fold-event-field sid kw j)) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)))
        (let ((fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value (+ entry (fn2-fold-event-field sid kw j)) event fn2-fields)))
         (fn2-succ-fill-fold-events (- k 1) (+ 1 j) sid kw entry events event fn2-fields)))
       (t (fn2-succ-fill-fold-events (- k 1) (+ 1 j) sid kw entry events event fn2-fields))))
(fn2-fields-preserves fn2-succ-fill-fold-events (k j sid kw entry events event fn2-fields) :position nil :raw-rows t
 :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-succ-has))))

; BATCH's newest private overlay of SID (greatest SEQ) among rows O.. (K of
; them); BEST the row count when none.
(defun fn2-succ-newest-private (k o b sid best fn2-overlays)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-overlays :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays) (natp o))))
 (if (not (and (posp k) (natp o) (< o (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays)))) best
  (fn2-succ-newest-private (- k 1) (+ 1 o) b sid
                           (if (and (equal (fn2-overlays-phase o fn2-overlays) *fn2-overlay-phase-private*)
                                    (equal (fn2-overlays-batch o fn2-overlays) b) (equal (fn2-overlays-schema o fn2-overlays) sid)
                                    (or (not (and (natp best) (< best (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays))))
                                        (< (nfix (fn2-overlays-seq best fn2-overlays)) (nfix (fn2-overlays-seq o fn2-overlays)))))
                               o best)
                           fn2-overlays)))
; The overlay slot rows of SID and SIZE bytes go into for BATCH: its newest
; private one with room, else a spare that becomes BATCH's (its SEQ the
; engine's next). (mv code o engine overlays)
(defun fn2-succ-target (b sid size fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays) :guard (and (fn2-id-engine-wfp fn2-id-engine) (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays))
  :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-overlays-rows)))))

      (o (fn2-succ-newest-private rows 0 b sid rows fn2-overlays))
      ((when (and (natp o) (< o rows)

       (mv :ok o fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays))

      ((unless (and (< s rows) (< 0 (fn2-id-engine-rows fn2-id-engine)) (unsigned-byte-p 60 b) (unsigned-byte-p 60 sid)))
       (mv :spare 0 fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays))
      (seq (+ 1 (nfix (fn2-id-engine-seq 0 fn2-id-engine))))
      ((unless (unsigned-byte-p 60 seq)) (mv :bounds 0 fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays))
      (fn2-id-engine (fn2-id-engine-set-seq 0 seq fn2-id-engine))
      (fn2-overlays (fn2-overlays-put s (phase *fn2-overlay-phase-private*) (batch b) (schema sid) (seq seq))))
  (mv :ok s fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays)))
(fn2-idc-op-shape fn2-succ-target (b sid size fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays) ((fn2-id-engine 2) (fn2-overlays 3))
 ((fn2-id-enginep fn2-id-engine) (fn2-id-engine-wfp fn2-id-engine) (fn2-overlaysp fn2-overlays) (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays)) :min

(in-theory (disable fn2-succ-target))

;; Bind slot S (slot I) of TX into BATCH.
(defun fn2-succ-bind-slot (i s b0 b event fn2-succ-slots fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool)

              (b* ((nf (nfix (fn2-run-layout-fields sid 0)))
                   (fn2-fields (fn2-succ-fill-events nf 0 entry (fn2-succ-slots-events s fn2-succ-slots) event fn2-fields))
                   (sslot (fn2-id-engine-slot 0 fn2-id-engine)) (sgen (fn2-id-engine-gen 0 fn2-id-engine))
                   ((unless (equal (fn2-succ-slots-oset s fn2-succ-slots) 1)) (mv :ok fn2-fields fn2-pool))
                   ((mv c fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-reset sslot sgen *fn2-idc-owner-kind* *fn2-idc-owner-slot* *fn2-idc-owner-gen* fn2-pool))

              (b* ((nk (nfix (fn2-run-layout-keys sid)))
                   (fn2-fields (fn2-succ-fill-fold-events *fn2-succ-fields-max* 0 sid (fn2-succ-kindkw code) entry
                                                          (fn2-succ-slots-events s fn2-succ-slots) event fn2-fields))
                   (sslot (fn2-id-engine-slot 0 fn2-id-engine)) (sgen (fn2-id-engine-gen 0 fn2-id-engine))
                   ((mv c fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-reset sslot sgen *fn2-idc-owner-kind* *fn2-idc-owner-slot* *fn2-idc-owner-gen* fn2-pool))

 (and (equal *fn2-principals-entry-field-principal* 1)
      (equal *fn2-identity-evidence-entry-field-occurrence* 8)
      (equal *fn2-article-entry-field-article* 0)

      (equal *fn2-overview-entry-field-article* 2)
      (equal *fn2-overview-entry-field-position* 3)

       (t (fn2-succ-fill-zero-events (- k 1) (+ 1 j) entry events event fn2-fields))))

;; The stream members of published batch B (E's fn2-commit-stream-wake,
;; attached to B's hook right after fn2-successor-publish, before any
;; transaction of B is released): its fn2-addr writes, one per call. Cursor
;; I = tx * W + slot walks the transaction rows bound to B (now :published)
;; and their non-empty addr slots, reading the staged row (its position the
;; member's commit position, filled at bind). An addr entry is a position in
;; its principal's own addr stream (e-surface.md 7), the stream a served
;; registration reads and parks on, so the member's stream is the entry's
;; principal (the entry's stream field is the stream it was selected through,
;; an item's detail). (mv code stream position next):

(defconst *fn2-succ-addr-sid* 4)

  :guard (and (fn2-succ-txns-wfp fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-succ-slots-wfp fn2-succ-slots) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (natp i))))
 (b* (((unless (and (posp k) (natp i) (< i (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots)))) (mv :done 0 0 0))
      (tx (floor i *fn2-succ-slots*)) (j (mod i *fn2-succ-slots*))
      ((unless (and (< tx (fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-succ-txns))
                    (equal (fn2-succ-txns-phase tx fn2-succ-txns) *fn2-succ-phase-published*)
                    (equal (fn2-succ-txns-batch tx fn2-succ-txns) b)
                    (not (equal (fn2-succ-slots-phase i fn2-succ-slots) *fn2-succ-slot-phase-empty*))
                    (equal (fn2-succ-slots-sid i fn2-succ-slots) *fn2-succ-addr-sid*)))
       (fn2-succ-stream-scan (- k 1) (+ 1 i) b fcrows fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-id-decides fn2-fields))
      ((mv c b0) (fn2-idc-stripe tx fcrows fn2-id-decides fn2-fields))
      ((unless (eq c :ok)) (mv c 0 0 0))
      (entry (+ b0 (* *fn2-succ-block* j)))
      ((unless (and (< (+ entry *fn2-addr-entry-field-principal*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))
                    (< (+ entry *fn2-addr-entry-field-position*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))))
       (mv :bounds 0 0 0)))
  (mv :ok (fn2-fields-value (+ entry *fn2-addr-entry-field-principal*) fn2-fields)
      (fn2-fields-value (+ entry *fn2-addr-entry-field-position*) fn2-fields) (+ 1 i))))

 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-id-decides fn2-fields fn2-fc) :guard t))

; Emit (C-S3 / B-S2 S12): after an :ok stage and any fill-octets, emit one
; fn2-format-txn-record frame + layout-encoded entry per non-empty applied

; (:ok :room :state :bounds).
(defun fn2-succ-emit-slot (i s b0 wslot wgen woff wmax len okind oslot ogen fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields fn2-pool)

  :guard (and (fn2-succ-slots-wfp fn2-succ-slots) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool)
              (natp s) (< s (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots)) (natp i) (natp b0) (natp woff) (natp wmax) (natp len))
  :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-format-txn-record-size fn2-format-txn-record-encode

                    (natp b0) (<= (+ b0 *fn2-idc-stride*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))

       (mv :bounds (nfix len) fn2-fields fn2-pool))

      (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value (+ fbase *fn2-format-txn-record-field-length*) rlen fn2-fields))
      (hlen (fn2-format-txn-record-size fbase fn2-fields))

                    (unsigned-byte-p 32 (+ woff len hlen))
                    (unsigned-byte-p 32 (+ woff len need))))

; Core wrappers, materialized after the core instance (assembly-callbacks-c,

; :bounds before anything is read.
(defmacro fn2-succ-wrap (name args children outs call &optional (code 'code) prefix)
 `(progn
   (defun ,name (,@args fn2-core)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
    (stobj-let ,children
     (,@prefix ,code ,@outs)
     ,call
     (mv ,@prefix ,code fn2-core)))
   (fn2-core-preserves ,name (,@args fn2-core) :position ,(+ 1 (len prefix)) :rows nil :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-core-wfp))))))

   (fn2-csnapshot-core-events)

    ((fn2-succ-txns (fn2-core-succ-txns fn2-core)) (fn2-succ-slots (fn2-core-succ-slots fn2-core)))
    (fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots)

; The stage-side wrappers, in their own assembly book (assembly-callbacks-c-
; commit): the one-minute rule (C-SUCCESSOR-BOOK).
;; A hook's attachment. Each constraint of the hook is proved of the
;; attachment by itself: the hook's -CONSTRAINT and -RESULT-CONSP (FN's
;; definition opened, its KIDS contract used), its KIDS by FN's contract and,
;; where the hook keeps the stored owners (commit.lisp
;; fn2-commit-hook-owners-claim), that by FN's owner chain (dispatch-held.lisp)
;; at the commit kind; the defattach then only cites them.
(defun fn2-succ-frame-nths (ks free out)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom ks) nil
  (cons `(:instance fn2-arm-kids-nth (i 0) (k ,(car ks)) (free ',free) (a fn2-core) (b ,out))
        (fn2-succ-frame-nths (cdr ks) free out))))
(defun fn2-succ-constraint-hints (hook fn world)
 ; the hook's -CONSTRAINT of FN from FN's preservation lemmas and its KIDS
 ; contract (the frame children are outside its children), FN closed
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (let ((free (fn2-arm-frame-indices (cdr (assoc-eq hook *fn2-commit-hook-children*)) world))
       (out `(mv-nth 1 (,fn ,@(formals hook world)))))
  `(("Goal" :in-theory (union-theories '(,@*fn2-commit-hook-frame* ,(fn2-columns-sym fn "-PRESERVES-TYPE")
                                         ,(fn2-columns-sym fn "-PRESERVES-WFP"))
                                       (theory 'fn2-arm-frame-base))
     :use ((:instance ,(fn2-columns-sym fn "-ARM-KIDS") (fn2-arm-free ',free) (fn2-arm-c0 fn2-core))
           (:instance fn2-arm-kids-refl (i 0) (free ',free) (a fn2-core))
           ,@(fn2-succ-frame-nths (fn2-arm-frame-indices *fn2-commit-hook-frame* world) free out))))))
(defun fn2-succ-attach-lemmas (names hook fn world)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom names) nil
  (let* ((thm (getpropc (fn2-columns-sym hook (car names)) 'untranslated-theorem nil world))
         (name (fn2-columns-sym fn (concatenate 'string "-HOOK" (car names))))
         (opened `(defthm ,name ,(subst fn hook thm)
                   :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable ,fn) :use ((:instance ,(fn2-columns-sym fn "-ARM-KIDS")))))
                   :rule-classes nil)))
   (cons (if (equal (car names) "-CONSTRAINT")
             `(make-event '(:or (defthm ,name ,(subst fn hook thm) :hints ,(fn2-succ-constraint-hints hook fn world)
                                  :rule-classes nil)
                                ,opened))
           opened)
         (fn2-succ-attach-lemmas (cdr names) hook fn world)))))
(defun fn2-succ-attach-form (hook fn world)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (let ((ownersp (getpropc (fn2-columns-sym hook "-OWNERS") 'theorem nil world)))
  `(progn
    ,@(fn2-succ-attach-lemmas '("-CONSTRAINT" "-RESULT-CONSP") hook fn world)
    (defattach (,hook ,fn)
     :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable ,fn)
              :use (,(fn2-columns-sym fn "-HOOK-CONSTRAINT") ,(fn2-columns-sym fn "-HOOK-RESULT-CONSP")
                    (:instance ,(fn2-columns-sym fn "-ARM-KIDS"))
                    ,@(and ownersp `((:instance ,(fn2-columns-pre "FN2-DH-OWNERS-OF-" fn) (fn2-dh-k *fn2-commit-kind*)))))))))))

   (in-theory (disable fn2-successor-stage fn2-successor-out fn2-successor-applied fn2-successor-fill-octets fn2-successor-emit fn2-successor-bind fn2-successor-release fn2-succ-core-publish fn2-successor-published fn2-successor-stream-member fn2-succ-core-drop fn2-succ-core-replay))
   (assert-event (fn2-assert-compliant-p '(fn2-successor-stage fn2-successor-out fn2-successor-applied fn2-successor-fill-octets fn2-successor-emit fn2-successor-bind fn2-successor-release fn2-succ-core-publish fn2-successor-published fn2-successor-stream-member fn2-succ-core-drop fn2-succ-core-replay) (w state)))))

after.books/runs-assemble.lisp:
; Layer C: the run assembly. FN2-RUN-ASSEMBLE runs once, after every
; DEFRUNSCHEMA of a world (a top-level assembly book; a unit after its test
; schemas). It generates the layout dispatcher over the registered schemas'
; codecs and key orders, with its shape lemmas proved by cases, then the
; append, page seek, build and lookup written once over the dispatcher and
; guard-verified there, the logic adapters and per-schema keystones, and a
; certify-time check that refuses any assembled schema whose build or lookup
; path reaches a function that is not guard-verified.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "overlay")
(fn2-book-layer :c)

; Dispatch arms over schema rows (NAME . ROW): one case arm per schema id.
; Level 0 selects the entry layout, a positive level the index layout.
(defun fn2-ra-layout-arms (rows suffix args)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom rows) nil
  (let* ((row (cdar rows)) (layouts (fn2-decl-get :layouts row)))
   (cons `(,(fn2-decl-get :id row)
           (if (and (integerp lv) (< 0 lv)) (,(fn2-columns-sym (cadr layouts) suffix) ,@args)
             (,(fn2-columns-sym (car layouts) suffix) ,@args)))
         (fn2-ra-layout-arms (cdr rows) suffix args)))))
(defun fn2-ra-layout-max-sizes (rows)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom rows) nil
  (let ((layouts (fn2-decl-get :layouts (cdar rows))))
   (cons (fn2-codec-constant (car layouts) "-MAX-SIZE")
    (cons (fn2-codec-constant (cadr layouts) "-MAX-SIZE")
          (fn2-ra-layout-max-sizes (cdr rows)))))))
(defun fn2-ra-layout-max-expression (sizes)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom sizes) 0 `(max ,(car sizes) ,(fn2-ra-layout-max-expression (cdr sizes)))))
(defun fn2-ra-max-size-arms (rows)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom rows) nil
  (let ((layouts (fn2-decl-get :layouts (cdar rows))))
   (cons `(,(fn2-decl-get :id (cdar rows))
           (if (and (integerp lv) (< 0 lv)) ,(fn2-codec-constant (cadr layouts) "-MAX-SIZE")
             ,(fn2-codec-constant (car layouts) "-MAX-SIZE")))
         (fn2-ra-max-size-arms (cdr rows))))))
(defun fn2-ra-count-arms (rows)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom rows) nil
  (let* ((row (cdar rows)) (layouts (fn2-decl-get :layouts row)))
   (cons `(,(fn2-decl-get :id row)
           (if (and (integerp lv) (< 0 lv)) ,(fn2-codec-constant (cadr layouts) "-NUM-FIELDS")
             ,(fn2-codec-constant (car layouts) "-NUM-FIELDS")))
         (fn2-ra-count-arms (cdr rows))))))
; The declared schema kind is consumed by writers and readers. Directory
; index pages remain :manifest; ordinary positive-level pages are :run-index.
(defun fn2-ra-fields-physical-ref-p (fields)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (and (consp fields) (or (equal (cadar fields) '(:id physical-unit)) (fn2-ra-fields-physical-ref-p (cdr fields)))))
(defun fn2-ra-physical-ref-arms (rows)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom rows) nil
  (cons `(,(fn2-decl-get :id (cdar rows))
          ,(if (fn2-ra-fields-physical-ref-p (append (fn2-decl-get :key (cdar rows)) (fn2-decl-get :value (cdar rows)))) t nil))
        (fn2-ra-physical-ref-arms (cdr rows)))))
(defun fn2-ra-page-kind-arms (rows)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom rows) nil
  (cons `(,(fn2-decl-get :id (cdar rows))
          ,(if (eq (fn2-decl-get :page-kind (cdar rows)) :manifest) '*page-kind-manifest*
             '(if (and (integerp lv) (< 0 lv)) *page-kind-run-index* *page-kind-run-data*)))
        (fn2-ra-page-kind-arms (cdr rows)))))
(defun fn2-ra-key-arms (rows)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom rows) nil
  (cons `(,(fn2-decl-get :id (cdar rows)) ,(len (fn2-decl-get :key (cdar rows))))
        (fn2-ra-key-arms (cdr rows)))))
(defun fn2-ra-compare-arms (rows)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom rows) nil
  (cons `(,(fn2-decl-get :id (cdar rows))
          (,(fn2-decl-get :compare (cdar rows)) abase bbase ak as ag bk bs bg fn2-fields fn2-pool))
        (fn2-ra-compare-arms (cdr rows)))))
(defun fn2-ra-merge-arms (rows)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom rows) nil
  (cons `(,(fn2-decl-get :id (cdar rows)) ,(fn2-decl-get :merge (cdar rows))) (fn2-ra-merge-arms (cdr rows)))))
(defun fn2-ra-fold-arms (rows)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((atom rows) nil)
       ((fn2-decl-get :fold (cdar rows))
        (cons `(,(fn2-decl-get :id (cdar rows)) (,(fn2-columns-sym (caar rows) "-FOLD-APPLY") kind vbase abase fn2-fields))
              (fn2-ra-fold-arms (cdr rows))))
       (t (fn2-ra-fold-arms (cdr rows)))))
;; What the private successor (C-S3) needs of each fold, from its declaration:
;; the arity of each event kind, which args are assigned, which arg each key
;; field is; and of every schema, which entry fields are octets.
(defun fn2-ra-pos (x xs)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((atom xs) 0) ((eq x (car xs)) 0) (t (+ 1 (fn2-ra-pos x (cdr xs))))))
(defun fn2-ra-poss (names xs)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom names) nil (cons (fn2-ra-pos (car names) xs) (fn2-ra-poss (cdr names) xs))))
(defun fn2-ra-evs (row) (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil)) (cadr (member-eq :events (fn2-decl-get :fold row))))
(defun fn2-ra-ev-assigns (ev) (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil)) (strip-cars (cadr (member-eq :assign (cddr ev)))))
(defun fn2-ra-key-arg-arms (knames args k)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom knames) nil (cons `(,k ,(fn2-ra-pos (car knames) args)) (fn2-ra-key-arg-arms (cdr knames) args (+ 1 k)))))
(defun fn2-ra-kind-arms (evs what key)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom evs) nil
  (let ((args (cadar evs)))
   (cons `(,(caar evs)
           ,(case what
             (:arity (len args))
             (:assigned `(if (member-equal j ',(fn2-ra-poss (fn2-ra-ev-assigns (car evs)) args)) t nil))
             (otherwise `(case k ,@(fn2-ra-key-arg-arms (strip-cars key) args 0) (otherwise nil)))))
         (fn2-ra-kind-arms (cdr evs) what key)))))
(defun fn2-ra-fold-info-arms (rows what)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((atom rows) nil)
       ((fn2-decl-get :fold (cdar rows))
        (cons `(,(fn2-decl-get :id (cdar rows))
                (case kind ,@(fn2-ra-kind-arms (fn2-ra-evs (cdar rows)) what (fn2-decl-get :key (cdar rows))) (otherwise nil)))
              (fn2-ra-fold-info-arms (cdr rows) what)))
       (t (fn2-ra-fold-info-arms (cdr rows) what))))
;; An event-filled arg (C-S3 grown for AUTHORITY-20261105 section 2's folds):
;; arg A of event EV whose :set copies it straight into one value field F,
;; (F A), and which nothing else reads (not a key, not assigned, absent from
;; :when, :assign and every other :set). Its value may be the member's own
;; commit position, :event at fn2-succ-arg: stage applies the step with 0 in
;; its place and bind writes the position into F (entry field NK + F's
;; position), so the post-image is the step over the event bind gave it.
(defun fn2-ra-occurs (x tree)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom tree) (eq x tree) (or (fn2-ra-occurs x (car tree)) (fn2-ra-occurs x (cdr tree)))))
(defun fn2-ra-straight-sets (a sets)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((atom sets) nil)
       ((eq (cadar sets) a) (cons (caar sets) (fn2-ra-straight-sets a (cdr sets))))
       (t (fn2-ra-straight-sets a (cdr sets)))))
(defun fn2-ra-other-sets (a sets)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((atom sets) nil)
       ((eq (cadar sets) a) (fn2-ra-other-sets a (cdr sets)))
       (t (cons (cadar sets) (fn2-ra-other-sets a (cdr sets))))))
(defun fn2-ra-event-arg-arms (args j ev knames vnames)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom args) nil
  (let* ((a (car args)) (sets (cadr (member-eq :set (cddr ev))))
         (fs (fn2-ra-straight-sets a sets))
         (ok (and (not (member-eq a knames)) (not (member-eq a (fn2-ra-ev-assigns ev)))
                  (equal (len fs) 1) (member-eq (car fs) vnames)
                  (not (fn2-ra-occurs a (cadr (member-eq :when (cddr ev)))))
                  (not (fn2-ra-occurs a (cadr (member-eq :assign (cddr ev)))))
                  (not (fn2-ra-occurs a (fn2-ra-other-sets a sets))))))
   (if ok (cons `(,j ,(+ (len knames) (fn2-ra-pos (car fs) vnames))) (fn2-ra-event-arg-arms (cdr args) (+ 1 j) ev knames vnames))
     (fn2-ra-event-arg-arms (cdr args) (+ 1 j) ev knames vnames)))))
(defun fn2-ra-event-kind-arms (evs knames vnames)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom evs) nil
  (cons `(,(caar evs) (case j ,@(fn2-ra-event-arg-arms (cadar evs) 0 (car evs) knames vnames) (otherwise nil)))
        (fn2-ra-event-kind-arms (cdr evs) knames vnames))))
(defun fn2-ra-event-field-arms (rows)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((atom rows) nil)
       ((fn2-decl-get :fold (cdar rows))
        (cons `(,(fn2-decl-get :id (cdar rows))
                (case kind ,@(fn2-ra-event-kind-arms (fn2-ra-evs (cdar rows)) (strip-cars (fn2-decl-get :key (cdar rows)))
                                                     (strip-cars (fn2-decl-get :value (cdar rows))))
                 (otherwise nil)))
              (fn2-ra-event-field-arms (cdr rows))))
       (t (fn2-ra-event-field-arms (cdr rows)))))
(defun fn2-ra-assign-arms (rows)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((atom rows) nil)
       ((fn2-decl-get :fold (cdar rows))
        (cons `(,(fn2-decl-get :id (cdar rows)) (,(fn2-columns-sym (caar rows) "-FOLD-ASSIGN") kind vbase abase fn2-fields))
              (fn2-ra-assign-arms (cdr rows))))
       (t (fn2-ra-assign-arms (cdr rows)))))
(defun fn2-ra-field-arms (fields i what)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom fields) nil
  (let* ((kind (cadar fields))
         (arm (case what
               (:octets (cond ((eq kind :digest) 32) ((and (consp kind) (eq (car kind) :octets)) (cadr kind)) (t nil)))
               (otherwise (cond ((member-eq kind '(:u8 :u16 :u32)) `(unsigned-byte-p ,(case kind (:u8 8) (:u16 16) (otherwise 32)) v))
                                ((eq kind :bool) '(unsigned-byte-p 1 v))
                                ((and (consp kind) (eq (car kind) :enum)) `(and (natp v) (< v ,(len (caddr kind)))))
                                ((eq kind :digest) '(equal v 32))
                                ((and (consp kind) (eq (car kind) :octets)) `(and (natp v) (<= v ,(cadr kind))))
                                (t nil))))))
   (if arm (cons `(,i ,arm) (fn2-ra-field-arms (cdr fields) (+ 1 i) what)) (fn2-ra-field-arms (cdr fields) (+ 1 i) what)))))
(defun fn2-ra-fields-arms (rows what)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom rows) nil
  (cons `(,(fn2-decl-get :id (cdar rows))
          (case f ,@(fn2-ra-field-arms (append (fn2-decl-get :key (cdar rows)) (fn2-decl-get :value (cdar rows))) 0 what)
           (otherwise ,(if (eq what :octets) nil t))))
        (fn2-ra-fields-arms (cdr rows) what))))
(defun fn2-ra-fold-ids (rows)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((atom rows) nil)
       ((fn2-decl-get :fold (cdar rows)) (cons (fn2-decl-get :id (cdar rows)) (fn2-ra-fold-ids (cdr rows))))
       (t (fn2-ra-fold-ids (cdr rows)))))
(defun fn2-ra-add-kinds (evs acc)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((atom evs) acc)
       ((member-eq (caar evs) acc) (fn2-ra-add-kinds (cdr evs) acc))
       (t (fn2-ra-add-kinds (cdr evs) (cons (caar evs) acc)))))
(defun fn2-ra-fold-kinds (rows acc)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom rows) (reverse acc)
  (fn2-ra-fold-kinds (cdr rows) (fn2-ra-add-kinds (fn2-ra-evs (cdar rows)) acc))))
(defun fn2-ra-ids (rows)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom rows) nil (cons (fn2-decl-get :id (cdar rows)) (fn2-ra-ids (cdr rows)))))

; The dispatcher. Every function is total over schema ids: an id no schema
; registered is refused :schema by the codec dispatch and has no fields.
(defun fn2-ra-dispatch-events (rows)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (let ((room '(and (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (natp base)
                   (<= (+ base *fn2-run-entry-rows*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)))))
 `((defconst *fn2-run-layout-max-entry-bytes* ,(fn2-ra-layout-max-expression (fn2-ra-layout-max-sizes rows)))
   (defun fn2-run-layout-physical-ref-p (sid)
    (declare (xargs :guard t))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-physical-ref-arms rows) (otherwise t)))
   (defun fn2-run-layout-page-kind (sid lv)
    (declare (xargs :guard t) (ignorable lv))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-page-kind-arms rows) (otherwise nil)))
   (defun fn2-run-layout-fields (sid lv)
    (declare (xargs :guard t) (ignorable lv))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-count-arms rows) (otherwise 0)))
   (defun fn2-run-layout-keys (sid)
    (declare (xargs :guard t))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-key-arms rows) (otherwise 0)))
   (defun fn2-run-layout-max-size (sid lv)
    (declare (xargs :guard t) (ignorable lv))
    (nfix (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-max-size-arms rows) (otherwise 0))))
   (defun fn2-run-layout-decode (sid lv base slot gen off end okind oslot ogen fn2-fields fn2-pool)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-fields fn2-pool) :guard (and ,room (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool)))
             (ignorable lv base slot gen end okind oslot ogen fn2-pool))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-layout-arms rows "-DECODE" '(base slot gen off end okind oslot ogen fn2-fields fn2-pool))
     (otherwise (mv :schema off fn2-fields))))
   (defun fn2-run-layout-encode (sid lv base slot gen off okind oslot ogen fn2-fields fn2-pool)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-fields fn2-pool) :guard (and ,room (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool)))
             (ignorable lv base slot gen okind oslot ogen fn2-fields))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-layout-arms rows "-ENCODE" '(base slot gen off okind oslot ogen fn2-fields fn2-pool))
     (otherwise (mv :schema off fn2-pool))))
   (defun fn2-run-layout-size (sid lv base fn2-fields)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-fields :guard ,room) (ignorable lv base fn2-fields))
    (nfix (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-layout-arms rows "-SIZE" '(base fn2-fields)) (otherwise 0))))
   (defun fn2-run-layout-compare (sid abase bbase ak as ag bk bs bg fn2-fields fn2-pool)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-fields fn2-pool)
     :guard (and (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool) (natp abase) (natp bbase)
                 (<= (+ abase *fn2-run-entry-rows*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))
                 (<= (+ bbase *fn2-run-entry-rows*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))))
             (ignorable abase bbase ak as ag bk bs bg fn2-fields fn2-pool))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-compare-arms rows) (otherwise (mv :schema :eq))))
   ;; The schema's merge rule (C-RANGE-NEWEST: a :latest overlay replaces
   ;; an equal key) and, for a fold, its served step over decoded rows.
   (defun fn2-run-layout-merge (sid)
    (declare (xargs :guard t))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-merge-arms rows) (otherwise :unique)))
   (defun fn2-fold-apply (sid kind vbase abase fn2-fields)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-fields :guard (and (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (natp vbase) (natp abase)))
             (ignorable sid kind vbase abase))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-fold-arms rows) (otherwise (mv :schema fn2-fields))))
   ;; The fold's assigned args of event KIND from the row at VBASE.
   (defun fn2-fold-assign (sid kind vbase abase fn2-fields)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-fields :guard (and (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (natp vbase) (natp abase)))
             (ignorable sid kind vbase abase))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-assign-arms rows) (otherwise (mv :schema fn2-fields))))
   ;; Event KIND of fold SID: its arity, or nil when it is none of the
   ;; fold's; whether its arg J is assigned; the arg that is key field K.
   (defun fn2-fold-arity (sid kind)
    (declare (xargs :guard t) (ignorable kind))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-fold-info-arms rows :arity) (otherwise nil)))
   (defun fn2-fold-assigned-p (sid kind j)
    (declare (xargs :guard t) (ignorable kind j))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-fold-info-arms rows :assigned) (otherwise nil)))
   (defun fn2-fold-key-arg (sid kind k)
    (declare (xargs :guard t) (ignorable kind k))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-fold-info-arms rows :key) (otherwise nil)))
   ;; The entry field bind fills with the member's commit position when
   ;; arg J of event KIND of fold SID is given :event, or nil when J may not
   ;; be (fn2-ra-event-arg-arms).
   (defun fn2-fold-event-field (sid kind j)
    (declare (xargs :guard t) (ignorable kind j))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-event-field-arms rows) (otherwise nil)))
   ;; Entry field F of schema SID: the greatest length when it is octets
   ;; (a digest's is 32), else nil; whether V fits it (for an octet field V
   ;; is the length: a digest's is exactly 32).
   (defun fn2-run-layout-octets-max (sid f)
    (declare (xargs :guard t) (ignorable f))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-fields-arms rows :octets) (otherwise nil)))
   (defun fn2-run-layout-value-ok (sid f v)
    (declare (xargs :guard t) (ignorable f v))
    (case sid ,@(fn2-ra-fields-arms rows :value) (otherwise nil)))
   (defun fn2-run-layout-fold-p (sid)
    (declare (xargs :guard t))
    (if (member-equal sid ',(fn2-ra-fold-ids rows)) t nil))
   (defconst *fn2-run-fold-kinds* ',(fn2-ra-fold-kinds rows nil))
   (defconst *fn2-run-assembled-ids* ',(fn2-ra-ids rows)))))

; A shape lemma (recognizer, invariant, rows) for each named output, proved
; with the recognizers and the named rows accessors folded.
(defmacro fn2-ra-shape (name call guard outputs disables)
 `(defthm ,name
   (implies ,guard (and ,@(fn2-fc-shape-claims outputs call)))
   :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-run-writersp fn2-run-writers-wfp fn2-run-restartsp fn2-run-restarts-wfp
                                       fn2-run-cursorsp fn2-run-cursors-wfp fn2-run-pathsp fn2-run-paths-wfp
                                       fn2-fieldsp fn2-fields-wfp fn2-poolp fn2-pool-wfp ,@disables)))))

; Shape lemmas, by cases over the arms, from each codec's own lemmas.
(defmacro fn2-ra-shape-events ()
 '(progn
   (defthm fn2-fold-apply-shape
    (implies (and (fn2-fieldsp fn2-fields) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields))
             (and (fn2-fieldsp (mv-nth 1 (fn2-fold-apply sid kind vbase abase fn2-fields)))
                  (fn2-fields-wfp (mv-nth 1 (fn2-fold-apply sid kind vbase abase fn2-fields)))
                  (equal (fn2-fields-rows (mv-nth 1 (fn2-fold-apply sid kind vbase abase fn2-fields)))
                         (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))))
    :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-fieldsp fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields-rows))))
   (defthm fn2-fold-assign-shape
    (implies (and (fn2-fieldsp fn2-fields) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields))
             (and (fn2-fieldsp (mv-nth 1 (fn2-fold-assign sid kind vbase abase fn2-fields)))
                  (fn2-fields-wfp (mv-nth 1 (fn2-fold-assign sid kind vbase abase fn2-fields)))
                  (equal (fn2-fields-rows (mv-nth 1 (fn2-fold-assign sid kind vbase abase fn2-fields)))
                         (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))))
    :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-fieldsp fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields-rows))))
   (defthm fn2-fold-key-arg-type
    (or (null (fn2-fold-key-arg sid kind k)) (natp (fn2-fold-key-arg sid kind k))) :rule-classes :type-prescription)
   (defthm fn2-fold-event-field-type
    (or (null (fn2-fold-event-field sid kind j)) (natp (fn2-fold-event-field sid kind j))) :rule-classes :type-prescription)
   (defthm fn2-fold-arity-type
    (or (null (fn2-fold-arity sid kind)) (natp (fn2-fold-arity sid kind))) :rule-classes :type-prescription)
   (defthm fn2-run-layout-octets-max-type
    (or (null (fn2-run-layout-octets-max sid f)) (natp (fn2-run-layout-octets-max sid f))) :rule-classes :type-prescription)
   (in-theory (disable fn2-fold-assign fn2-fold-arity fn2-fold-assigned-p fn2-fold-key-arg fn2-fold-event-field
                       fn2-run-layout-octets-max fn2-run-layout-value-ok fn2-run-layout-fold-p))
   (defthm fn2-run-layout-decode-shape
    (implies (and (fn2-fieldsp fn2-fields) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields))
             (and (fn2-fieldsp (mv-nth 2 (fn2-run-layout-decode sid lv base slot gen off end okind oslot ogen fn2-fields fn2-pool)))
                  (fn2-fields-wfp (mv-nth 2 (fn2-run-layout-decode sid lv base slot gen off end okind oslot ogen fn2-fields fn2-pool)))
                  (equal (fn2-fields-rows (mv-nth 2 (fn2-run-layout-decode sid lv base slot gen off end okind oslot ogen fn2-fields fn2-pool)))
                         (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))))
    :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-fieldsp fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields-rows))))

               ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code lo hi idx off fn2-fields))

         ((mv code order) (fn2-run-layout-compare sid eb qbase pk ps pg qk qs qg fn2-fields fn2-pool))
         ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code lo hi idx off fn2-fields)))

      (:gt (mv :absent lo hi idx off fn2-fields))

    (implies (and (fn2-fieldsp fn2-fields) (fn2-run-readerp rb fn2-fields))
             (and (fn2-fieldsp (mv-nth 5 (fn2-run-seek sid lv steps lo hi idx off qbase rb slot gen pk ps pg qk qs qg fn2-fields fn2-pool)))

;; Lookup and scan. FN2-RUN-NTH decodes entry K of a read page at level LV
;; into the reader's entry rows (restart, then at most 15 skips) and returns

;; or the final :found / :absent with the level-0 entry decoded in the reader
;; rows. Every page the descent visits is noted in the cursor's path.
;; FN2-RUN-SCAN-STEP continues from a lower bound: :entry (the next entry in

          ((unless (and (eq code :ok) (natp next) (< off next))) (mv (if (eq code :ok) :format code) off fn2-fields)))

    (and (fn2-fieldsp fn2-fields) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields)) ((fn2-fields 2)))

    (implies (natp off) (natp (mv-nth 1 (fn2-run-skip sid lv m off slot gen rb okind oslot ogen fn2-fields fn2-pool))))
    :rule-classes :type-prescription)

     :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-fields-rows fn2-run-restart-offset)))))
